the development of accurate analytical models for join algorithms.
the development of an efficient analytical model that captures key performance characteristics of the hybrid hash algorithm and can be used by a query optimizer to choose efficient query plans.
the development of accurate cost models for database query processing algorithms.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed an analytical model for the hybrid hash join, which is accurate enough for use in a query optimizer, but is still simple enough to be used for the purpose of performance prediction.
we have developed an accurate model of the hybrid hash-join algorithm, and that we have validated the model by comparing it against the results of a detailed simulation.
we have developed an analytical model of the hybrid hash algorithm which is accurate and fast, and which captures all of the important performance features of the hybrid hash method.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a good analytical model of a complex query processing algorithm can be built by identifying key factors that affect its performance and then developing a simple model for each factor.

a simple analytical model can be used to predict the performance of the hybrid hash algorithm with a high degree of accuracy, and that this model is much simpler than a detailed simulation of the hybrid hash operator.

a simple, accurate model of the hybrid hash algorithm can be built from a small set of easily measured parameters, including the size of the relations to be joined, the number of disks available to the join, the number of processors in the system, and the disk seek times and transfer rates.
